title: Available applications assigned to All Users without a filter
when: it.Assignments.Any(a => !a.IsExclusion && a.Intent != null && (a.Intent == 'available' || a.Intent == 'availableWithoutEnrollment') && a.IsAllUsers && a.FilterId == null)

report.title: {Items.Count} available {Plural(Items.Count, 'application is', 'applications are')} offered to All Users without a filter

messages.businessImpact: Every licensed user sees software in Company Portal whether they need it or not, which spreads unsupported titles and muddies what the organisation actually standardises on.
remediation: Narrow available assignments to the groups that should see the title, or add an include filter that matches the intended device or ownership shape.
messages.cannotSee: Required assignments to All Users are a different question. Whether Company Portal is deployed is APP-011. Exclude filters on the same assignment are ignored for this raise.
